description: This file is a shell script for testing performance of various 'git rev-list' commands, including setup steps like creating dummy files and commits.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test for a given git rev-list command string.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test that expects success with a given description.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_export
